description.value: Just Matcha is a specialty matcha tea shop founded in 2013 by Tiffanie and Kip Home, now operating from its second Victoria home on Pandora Avenue after its original Oak Bay Avenue location closed during the pandemic. The shop sources a curated range of premium Japanese matcha powders, traditional bowls, and accessories, built on years of hands-on sourcing expertise. Cyclists passing through downtown Victoria will find a focused specialist with deep matcha knowledge and an authentic product selection.
